description: Extend an existing server's lease so it is not auto-destroyed at expiry. SPENDS REAL USDC — signed on-chain via x402 (Base) up to the per-call spend cap; a real charge. Adds `days` days to the current expiry and returns the new expiry (unix seconds). Use before a lease runs out to keep a box alive; check the current expiry first with get_server.

days.description: Whole days to add to the current lease (1–30).

name: extend_server
title: Extend a server lease
